title: Discord linking turns joining the community into a Quest
summary:
A community-heavy day: Discord rewards, three new apps, and MCP agents that can search the web or stitch media together.

Accounts can now link one Discord identity alongside GitHub sign-in, see their Pollinations server connection, and claim 1 Pollen for joining. The Quest path was also simplified behind the scenes: server-side verification and the reward remain, with fewer dashboard requests involved.

The app directory gained Pollinations App for wallet-connected image generation, Dery AI for collaborative image-making, and Descriptly, which uses vision models to suggest accessible alt text for images changed in pull requests. The README now keeps the recent-apps and project-activity picture current too.

Agents can now search and fetch web content through a private Exa MCP integration without forwarding caller credentials. FFmpeg MCP also learned to accept multiple public inputs, so a single job can combine separate video, audio, and other media files before returning a hosted output.
